summary: Skipped questions have disabled select frames with valid IDs. Recognize the observed skipped grade when extracting those frames. Offline execution was attempted but Chromium could not launch because the read-only filesystem prevents creating its temporary directory.
regression_test:
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

SOURCE = Path(__file__).with_name('dom.js')
EVIDENCE = Path('/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14035554/diagnostics/1791416448778551272/page.html')
OLD = "const graded = ['Correct','Incorrect'].includes(element.querySelector('.questionWidget-result')?.textContent.trim());"
NEW = "const graded = ['Correct','Incorrect','Skipped Question'].includes(element.querySelector('.questionWidget-result')?.textContent.trim());"
ERRORS = ['Select frame has no ID: selectList-339145-0', 'Select frame has no ID: selectList-339145-1']

class SkippedSelectTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.source = SOURCE.read_text()
        cls.original = cls.source.replace(NEW, OLD)
        cls.saved = EVIDENCE.read_text()
        cls.runtime = sync_playwright().start()
        cls.browser = cls.runtime.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        cls.context = cls.browser.new_context(java_script_enabled=False)
        cls.context.route('**/*', lambda route: route.abort())
        cls.page = cls.context.new_page()

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls.context.close()
        cls.browser.close()
        cls.runtime.stop()

    def setUp(self):
        self.page.set_content(self.saved, wait_until='domcontentloaded')
        self.scope = self.page.locator('#questionContainer')

    def test_original_failure_from_saved_page(self):
        item = self.scope.evaluate(self.original)
        self.assertEqual(item['result'], 'Skipped Question')
        self.assertEqual(item['errors'], ERRORS)
        self.assertEqual(len(item['fields']), 2)
        self.assertTrue(all(not f['choices_complete'] for f in item['fields']))

    def test_skipped_page_preserves_complete_content(self):
        original = self.scope.evaluate(self.original)
        item = self.scope.evaluate(self.source)
        self.assertEqual(item['errors'], [])
        self.assertEqual(item['result'], 'Skipped Question')
        self.assertEqual(item['problem'], original['problem'])
        self.assertEqual(item['worked_solution'], original['worked_solution'])
        self.assertTrue(item['worked_solution'])
        self.assertEqual(item['assets'], original['assets'])
        self.assertEqual(len(item['fields']), 2)
        for index, field in enumerate(item['fields']):
            self.assertEqual(field['dom_id'], 'selectList-339145-' + str(index))
            self.assertEqual(field['frame_id'], 'selectListFrame-339145-' + str(index))
            self.assertEqual(field['choices'], original['fields'][index]['choices'])
            self.assertEqual(len(field['choices']), 4)
            self.assertTrue(field['choices_complete'])

    def test_disabled_unanswered_or_unknown_result_still_rejected(self):
        for result in ('', 'Pending', 'Skipped'):
            with self.subTest(result=result):
                self.scope.locator('.questionWidget-result').evaluate('(node, text) => node.textContent = text', result)
                item = self.scope.evaluate(self.source)
                self.assertEqual(item['errors'], ERRORS)
                self.assertTrue(all(not f['choices_complete'] for f in item['fields']))

    def test_missing_observed_frame_id_still_rejected(self):
        self.scope.locator('#selectListFrame-339145-0').evaluate('(node) => node.removeAttribute("id")')
        item = self.scope.evaluate(self.source)
        self.assertEqual(item['errors'], ERRORS[:1])
        self.assertTrue(all(not f['choices_complete'] for f in item['fields']))

    def test_existing_grades_remain_supported(self):
        for result in ('Correct', 'Incorrect'):
            with self.subTest(result=result):
                self.scope.locator('.questionWidget-result').evaluate('(node, text) => node.textContent = text', result)
                item = self.scope.evaluate(self.source)
                self.assertEqual(item['errors'], [])
                self.assertTrue(all(f['choices_complete'] for f in item['fields']))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
